_comment: Declared outbound network destinations for the FaceAuth runtime.
This list is now EMPTY, which is the state blocker B17 requires: the
runtime is expected to contact nothing at all, and any observed external
destination is a failure rather than something to be declared.
It previously held one entry, play.googleapis.com:443, reached from Google
Clearcut telemetry code inside the bundled mediapipe wheel's
libmediapipe.dll on task-session teardown, with no upstream opt-out
because the dependency is removed: the liveness path now runs the same
pinned face_landmarker.task weights on ai-edge-litert, through the graph
reimplemented in faceauth.liveness.litert_landmarker. The full account of
the original behaviour is kept in docs/PRIVACY_NETWORK_AUDIT.md and
ADR-0005 - removing the entry does not erase the history.
scripts/check_network_activity.py fails if the runtime contacts anything
NOT listed here. With an empty list that means: anything at all. Adding an
entry back is a deliberate act requiring the same investigation the
original got - destination, trigger, transmitted data, and whether it can
be turned off - and would re-open B17.
